title: Royal Seaview | Benchmark Management Vacation Rental
meta_description: Royal Seaview is a 4.00 bedroom, 4.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Perfect Vacation Retreat:Location: 5-minute walk to private beach access or free tram service (Mar – Oct) with closest stop 2 houses East at E6, 2-minute walk to the massive community pool, 1 block from 30A, 1-minute walk to Starbucks and Village of South Walton, 6-minute walk to Rosemary Beach shops/restaurants, 8-minute walk to Alys Beach shops/restaurants, 30Avenue shops/restaurants less than 1 mile across HWY 98, Inlet Beach (large public beach access) a short 1-mile drive/bike awaySpacious Home: Luxurious 2,505 square foot home beautifully decorated with 4 large bedrooms (3 king ensuites) + queen sleeper sofa and 4 full bathrooms accommodating up to 12 guests, 2 separate living areas, 6 Smart TV’s, GE washer/dryer, fully equipped gourmet kitchen with stainless steel GE appliances + Welcome Gifts!Sleeping Arrangements:1st Floor, Bedroom 1: King bed, Smart TV. Private bathroom with walk-in shower.1st Floor, Bedroom 2: King bed, Smart TV. Private bathroom with dual sinks and walk-in shower.2nd Floor, Bedroom 3: Twin-over-twin bunk, twin daybed w/twin trundle, Smart TV. Direct access to guest bathroom with walk-in shower.3rd Floor, Bedroom 4: King bed. Pack ‘N Play in closet. Private bathroom with claw-foot tub and walk-in rainfall shower.3rd Floor, Queen sleeper sofa in the 2nd living area.3 Outdoor Spaces: Amazing outdoor Gulf facing covered deck on 3rd floor with comfortable group seating, incredible views, wall mounted flat screen Smart TV and kitchen with top-of-the-line gas grill, sink and mini-fridge, 2nd floor outdoor balcony with relaxing seating surrounded by palm trees, and 1st floor porch with additional seatingKid Friendly: Fun bunk room sleeps up to 4, Pack ‘N Play, highchair, kid utensils, baby gatesDog Friendly: 1 dog up to 30 pounds; an additional non-refundable pet fee will be added to your booking. Please contact us if you are bringing a dog. Multiple nature trails with dog waste stations are positioned throughout the neighborhood, with Seagull Park being the closest at a 1-minute walk around the corner. Dog bowls are provided.In Home Entertainment: High speed wireless Internet, Cable TV, 6 Flat Screen Smart TV’s, Bluetooth connection to speaker system, puzzles/board games in living room coffee table chestBeach Accessories: 4 beach chairs, 2 boogie boards, 2 jumbo beach umbrellas/bases, 3 noodles and a variety of beach toys. Outdoor shower on the right side of house.Bike Access: 4 bikes are conveniently located at the bike rack on the right side of the house. If you would like to rent them during your stay, a direct link will be provided.Parking: 3 free parking spaces in front of the houseWelcome Gifts: A Benchmark welcome bag and initial starter kit of amenities are provided for all guests. For the kitchen this includes: 6 K-Cups, 6 chocolates, coffee filters, sugar/sweetener, salt/pepper, 1 roll of paper towels, 1 dish sponge, 1 dish soap, 2 dishwasher pods, and 1 liner for each trashcan. For each bathroom it includes: 1 roll of toilet paper, 1 set of soap/body wash/shampoo/conditioner/lotion. For towels you will receive: 1 body towel/1 washcloth per guest and 2 hand towels per bathroom, plus 2 washing machine pods.Experience the ultimate coastal getaway at Royal Seaview! The stunning beachy chic decor creates a serene, sophisticated atmosphere that feels like your own private paradise. You will find yourself in instant relaxation mode once you step outside on the expansive, covered 3rd floor balcony. This is the perfect spot for coffee at sunrise or a cocktail at sunset and one of the numerous highlights of this exquisite home.Whether you’re enjoying a day on the beach or at the pool, unwinding in one of the many calming spaces in your beach house, discovering nearby vibrant shops and restaurants, or taking advantage of the countless exciting attractions, this is the ideal place to call home during your beach getaway.
